verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE runs inside Slack. Responders can tag @betterstack during an incident to have it investigate, and it produces an automated post-mortem from the incident timeline and Slack. That gives AI-written incident documentation, but only after the fact rather than live as the incident unfolds. Missing for 10: live running incident summaries, AI-drafted stakeholder or status-page updates, scribed call or bridge notes, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
